content.text: Digital creators in Nigeria, Ghana, Pakistan, and other regions face a stark reality: Stripe operates in only 46 of 195 countries, and PayPal can suspend accounts—holding funds for up to 180 days with no appeal. This isn’t a minor inconvenience; it’s a structural lockout from global commerce. If you sell digital art, templates, or courses, this [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-infrastructure-south-asian-creators-my-unfiltered-take-3|Payment Infrastructure]]-gateways-cameroon-digital-products|infrastructure]] gap means your business depends on platforms that exclude you by design. The solution isn’t a workaround—it’s base-layer infrastructure sovereignty. This post breaks down how to deploy your own commerce stack, independent of Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, or [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/lemon-squeezy-alternatives-restricted-countries-which-architecture-actually-5|COREMERCH guide to lemon]] Squeezy. Own your store. Own your payments. Own your data.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-selling-digital-products-without-stripe-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Digital paypal

This is not a plugin or a third-party service. It’s a complete commerce stack built on open infrastructure. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages host your storefront for free. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle backend logic without servers. Supabase or Google Sheets store orders. Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 delivers files instantly. NOWPayments verifies crypto payments on-chain with a 0.5% fee. No subscriptions. No platform lock-in. No country restrictions. You own the code, the data, and the deployment. This architecture is pressure-tested in Zimbabwe, where currency collapse and payment rejections are the norm. It’s built for creators who need sovereignty, not workarounds.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

Start with a static site generator like Jekyll or Hugo to build your storefront. Host it on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for zero hosting fees. Backend logic runs on Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, triggered by user actions like purchase buttons. Orders are logged in Supabase (a free Postgres database) or Google Sheets. File delivery uses signed URLs from Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, ensuring only paid customers access your digital art. Payments are processed via NOWPayments, which supports 300+ cryptocurrencies and fires a webhook the moment payment confirms on-chain. No buyer account required. No KYC. The entire stack is stateless, serverless, and globally distributed. You deploy it once—it runs forever.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This is for digital creators selling non-physical products: ebooks, fonts, presets, beats, software, or digital art. If Stripe, PayPal, or Gumroad are unavailable or unreliable in your country, this stack gives you structural independence. It’s for creators who refuse to rent their business infrastructure. For example, a graphic designer in Lagos can sell templates globally, accepting USDT on TRON for under $0.03 per transaction. A course creator in Karachi can deliver video files instantly after payment confirms. The stack is designed for regions where financial exclusion is the norm, but it works anywhere. You’re not building a store—you’re deploying infrastructure.
Stripe operates in only 46 of 195 countries—this stack works in all 195.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages provide free, global CDN hosting. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script execute backend tasks like order processing. Supabase or Google Sheets store transaction data. Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 serves files securely. NOWPayments handles crypto payments with a 0.5% fee, no KYC, and automatic webhooks. Each component is independent but integrates via APIs. For example, a Cloudflare Worker receives a payment confirmation webhook from NOWPayments, logs the order in Supabase, and generates a signed URL for file delivery from R2. The stack is modular—swap components as needed. Use BSC, Solana, or TRON for low-fee transactions. The entire system is open, auditable, and yours to modify.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Start by mapping your product flow: storefront, payment, order storage, file delivery. Choose your stack components based on technical comfort. For example, use GitHub Pages + Apps Script + Google Sheets if you’re new to coding. Use Cloudflare Pages + Workers + Supabase for more control. Deploy NOWPayments for crypto processing—configure webhooks to trigger order fulfillment. Test end-to-end before going live. Load your first product, share the link, and monitor transactions. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) deploys this architecture for you in 48 hours, including SPF/DKIM/DMARC email setup and 30-day support. Or build it yourself using the Sovereign Blueprint ($47) docs. Either way, the outcome is the same: your store runs on infrastructure you own, not platforms that exclude you.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

If Stripe is unavailable in your country, deploy a sovereign commerce stack using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and NOWPayments for crypto transactions. This architecture bypasses platform restrictions by using globally accessible, open-source tools. For example, a creator in Kenya can accept USDC on Solana with fees under $0.10 per transaction. The stack is stateless, serverless, and requires no third-party approvals. You own the deployment—no one can suspend your access or hold your funds.
PayPal can hold your funds for 180 days with no appeal—this architecture eliminates intermediaries.

Creators searching for Stripe alternatives in Nigeria or Gumroad replacements in Pakistan will find this architecture directly applicable. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) deploys this system for you in 48 hours, including five products loaded and end-to-end testing. For those who prefer to build independently, the Sovereign Blueprint ($47) provides full documentation and source code. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to choose your path. Whether you deploy yourself or use a pre-built stack, the outcome is the same: your business runs on infrastructure you control, not platforms that exclude you.
Your Deployment Checklist

Map your product flow: storefront, payment, order storage, file delivery. Choose hosting: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Set up backend logic: Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Configure order storage: Supabase or Google Sheets. Enable file delivery: Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Integrate payments: NOWPayments with webhooks. Test end-to-end: simulate a purchase, verify file delivery. Deploy live: share your storefront URL. Monitor transactions: track orders in Supabase or Sheets. Scale as needed: add products, optimize workflows. For a fully deployed solution, purchase the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this stack if I’m not a developer?

Yes. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) deploys the architecture for you in 48 hours, including five products and 30-day support. Alternatively, use the Sovereign Blueprint ($47) for step-by-step documentation and templates. Both options require no coding if you choose Google Sheets and Apps Script.
What cryptocurrencies should I accept for low fees?

Use BSC (BNB), Solana (USDC), or TRON (USDT) for transaction fees under $0.10. NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies, but these networks are optimized for speed and cost. Configure your payment page to display preferred currencies first.
How do I handle refunds or chargebacks?

Crypto transactions are irreversible, so refunds are handled manually by sending funds back to the customer’s wallet. Communicate this policy clearly on your storefront. For chargebacks, since crypto payments are on-chain, there’s no risk of reversed transactions—you keep the funds once confirmed.
Can I use this stack for physical products?

No. This architecture is designed for digital products with instant delivery. Physical goods require shipping integration, inventory management, and additional compliance. For digital creators, this stack provides everything needed to sell globally without platform restrictions.
What happens if NOWPayments goes down?

NOWPayments operates on a decentralized network, but if their service is unavailable, payments will fail until restored. To mitigate, use a fallback payment processor like Coinbase Commerce or manually accept payments via wallet addresses. The stack’s modular design allows you to swap components as needed.
Your store runs on infrastructure you own, not platforms that exclude you by design.
